open_source_models.policy: All four free models stay connected on each analysis cycle. Only reliable votes enter consensus; low-quality outputs remain visible but cannot influence execution.

adaptive_learning.policy: Evidence may modestly adjust confidence/execution scores and can downgrade EXECUTE_NOW. It cannot create or reverse a BUY/SELL.
